catalog_item_subtype_valid.name: catalog_item_subtype_valid
catalog_item_subtype_valid.value: ("catalog_items"."type" = 'event' AND "catalog_items"."subtype" IN ('tournament', 'league', 'clinic', 'open-play', 'pickup')) OR ("catalog_items"."type" = 'service' AND "catalog_items"."subtype" IN ('private-lesson', 'group-lesson', 'program', 'court-rental', 'assessment', 'other')) OR ("catalog_items"."type" = 'good' AND "catalog_items"."subtype" IN ('apparel', 'equipment', 'rental', 'swag', 'consumable', 'other')) OR ("catalog_items"."type" = 'plan' AND "catalog_items"."subtype" IN ('membership', 'credit-pack'))

catalog_price_value_valid.name: catalog_price_value_valid
catalog_price_value_valid.value: ("catalog_prices"."payment_kind" = 'credit' AND "catalog_prices"."credit_amount" > 0 AND "catalog_prices"."amount_minor" IS NULL AND "catalog_prices"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("catalog_prices"."payment_kind" IN ('card', 'cash') AND "catalog_prices"."amount_minor" >= 0 AND "catalog_prices"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_prices"."credit_amount" IS NULL)

catalog_price_recurring_valid.name: catalog_price_recurring_valid
catalog_price_recurring_valid.value: ("catalog_prices"."recurring_interval" IS NULL AND "catalog_prices"."recurring_interval_count" IS NULL) OR ("catalog_prices"."recurring_interval" IN ('week', 'month', 'year') AND "catalog_prices"."recurring_interval_count" > 0)

catalog_price_window_valid.name: catalog_price_window_valid
catalog_price_window_valid.value: "catalog_prices"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "catalog_prices"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "catalog_prices"."ends_at" > "catalog_prices"."starts_at"

court_booking_participant_identity.name: court_booking_participant_identity
court_booking_participant_identity.value: "court_booking_participants"."person_id" IS NOT NULL OR "court_booking_participants"."invited_email" IS NOT NULL OR "court_booking_participants"."invited_phone_e164" IS NOT NULL

event_policy_acceptance_reference.name: event_policy_acceptance_reference
event_policy_acceptance_reference.value: "event_policy_acceptances"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "event_policy_acceptances"."registration_id" IS NOT NULL

feature_flag_organization_unique.name: feature_flag_organization_unique
feature_flag_organization_unique.where: "feature_flags"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "feature_flags"."market" IS NULL

feature_flag_market_unique.name: feature_flag_market_unique
feature_flag_market_unique.where: "feature_flags"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "feature_flags"."market" IS NOT NULL

feature_flag_organization_market_unique.name: feature_flag_organization_market_unique
feature_flag_organization_market_unique.where: "feature_flags"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "feature_flags"."market" IS NOT NULL

form_response_signature_complete.name: form_response_signature_complete
form_response_signature_complete.value: ("form_responses"."signed_by_person_id" IS NULL AND "form_responses"."signature_text_hash" IS NULL AND "form_responses"."signed_at" IS NULL) OR ("form_responses"."signed_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "form_responses"."signature_text_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "form_responses"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL)

form_document_hash_pair.name: form_document_hash_pair
form_document_hash_pair.value: ("forms"."document_text" IS NULL AND "forms"."document_text_hash" IS NULL) OR ("forms"."document_text" IS NOT NULL AND "forms"."document_text_hash" IS NOT NULL)

guardian_invitation_claim_state_valid.name: guardian_invitation_claim_state_valid
guardian_invitation_claim_state_valid.value: ("guardian_invitations"."status" = 'claimed' AND "guardian_invitations"."claimed_by_person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "guardian_invitations"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("guardian_invitations"."status" <> 'claimed')

inventory_stock_acquisition_amounts.name: inventory_stock_acquisition_amounts
inventory_stock_acquisition_amounts.value: "inventory_stock_items"."unit_cost_minor" IS NULL OR ("inventory_stock_items"."unit_cost_minor" >= 0 AND "inventory_stock_items"."currency" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_account_unit_currency_valid.name: ledger_account_unit_currency_valid
ledger_account_unit_currency_valid.value: ("ledger_accounts"."unit_kind" = 'money' AND "ledger_accounts"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."unit" = "ledger_accounts"."currency") OR ("ledger_accounts"."unit_kind" = 'organization-credit' AND "ledger_accounts"."currency" IS NULL)

ledger_entry_unit_currency_valid.name: ledger_entry_unit_currency_valid
ledger_entry_unit_currency_valid.value: ("ledger_entries"."unit_kind" = 'money' AND "ledger_entries"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_entries"."unit" = "ledger_entries"."currency") OR ("ledger_entries"."unit_kind" = 'organization-credit' AND "ledger_entries"."currency" IS NULL)

ledger_journal_posted_state_valid.name: ledger_journal_posted_state_valid
ledger_journal_posted_state_valid.value: ("ledger_journals"."status" = 'draft' AND "ledger_journals"."posted_at" IS NULL) OR ("ledger_journals"."status" = 'posted' AND "ledger_journals"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL)

match_team_distinct.name: match_team_distinct
match_team_distinct.value: "matches"."team_a_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."team_b_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."team_a_id" <> "matches"."team_b_id"

organization_credit_application_value_va.name: organization_credit_application_value_valid
organization_credit_application_value_va.value: "organization_credit_applications"."value_minor" >= 0 AND (("organization_credit_applications"."value_minor" = 0 AND "organization_credit_applications"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("organization_credit_applications"."value_minor" > 0 AND "organization_credit_applications"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_credit_applications"."currency" = upper("organization_credit_applications"."currency")))

organization_credit_grant_value_valid.name: organization_credit_grant_value_valid
organization_credit_grant_value_valid.value: "organization_credit_grants"."initial_value_minor" >= 0 AND "organization_credit_grants"."remaining_value_minor" >= 0 AND "organization_credit_grants"."remaining_value_minor" <= "organization_credit_grants"."initial_value_minor" AND (("organization_credit_grants"."initial_value_minor" = 0 AND "organization_credit_grants"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("organization_credit_grants"."initial_value_minor" > 0 AND "organization_credit_grants"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_credit_grants"."currency" = upper("organization_credit_grants"."currency")))

organization_invitation_destination_pres.name: organization_invitation_destination_present
organization_invitation_destination_pres.value: "organization_invitations"."invited_email" IS NOT NULL OR "organization_invitations"."invited_phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "organization_invitations"."guardian_email" IS NOT NULL OR "organization_invitations"."guardian_phone_e164" IS NOT NULL

organization_invitation_minor_guardian_p.name: organization_invitation_minor_guardian_present
organization_invitation_minor_guardian_p.value: NOT "organization_invitations"."is_minor" OR "organization_invitations"."guardian_email" IS NOT NULL OR "organization_invitations"."guardian_phone_e164" IS NOT NULL

pickup_participant_pending_hold_required.name: pickup_participant_pending_hold_required
pickup_participant_pending_hold_required.value: "pickup_participants"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("pickup_participants"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_participants"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

pickup_session_rating_range_valid.name: pickup_session_rating_range_valid
pickup_session_rating_range_valid.value: ("pickup_sessions"."rating_minimum" IS NULL AND "pickup_sessions"."rating_maximum" IS NULL) OR ("pickup_sessions"."rating_minimum" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_sessions"."rating_maximum" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_sessions"."rating_maximum" >= "pickup_sessions"."rating_minimum")

rate_plan_amounts_nonnegative.name: rate_plan_amounts_nonnegative
rate_plan_amounts_nonnegative.value: "rate_plans"."base_amount_minor" >= 0 AND ("rate_plans"."member_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "rate_plans"."member_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("rate_plans"."non_member_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "rate_plans"."non_member_amount_minor" >= 0)

registration_pending_hold_required.name: registration_pending_hold_required
registration_pending_hold_required.value: "registrations"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("registrations"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "registrations"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

ticket_sales_window_valid.name: ticket_sales_window_valid
ticket_sales_window_valid.value: "ticket_types"."sales_starts_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."sales_ends_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."sales_ends_at" > "ticket_types"."sales_starts_at"

ticket_validity_window_valid.name: ticket_validity_window_valid
ticket_validity_window_valid.value: "ticket_types"."validity_starts_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."validity_ends_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."validity_ends_at" > "ticket_types"."validity_starts_at"
